title: Secret of Evermore
subtitle: Square USA · Super Nintendo Entertainment System
summary: Secret of Evermore is Square's Super Nintendo action role-playing adventure about a boy and his dog transported into a strange artificial world. Its regions resemble prehistory, classical antiquity, the Middle Ages and an imagined future, giving the pair a succession of different surroundings to investigate. The dog changes appearance between those regions while remaining the boy's companion. The journey combines real-time fighting with a search for a way home, using the relationship between the two travellers to connect places that otherwise seem to belong to different histories.
body: Secret of Evermore is Square's Super Nintendo action role-playing adventure about a boy and his dog transported into a strange artificial world. Its regions resemble prehistory, classical antiquity, the Middle Ages and an imagined future, giving the pair a succession of different surroundings to investigate. The dog changes appearance between those regions while remaining the boy's companion. The journey combines real-time fighting with a search for a way home, using the relationship between the two travellers to connect places that otherwise seem to belong to different histories.

The player can switch control between the boy and dog, leaving the other to act automatically. The boy uses weapons, while the dog can help locate ingredients for alchemy. Those ingredients supply spells, tying a useful battle ability to what has been discovered around the environment. A circular menu makes equipment and alchemy accessible during play. Attacks also use a recharging strength gauge, encouraging the player to leave enough time between blows rather than expect repeated swings to deliver their full effect.

Developed by a North American Square team, Evermore shares interface and combat ideas with Secret of Mana while building its own setting around imagined historical periods and the boy's affection for old films. Weapons develop through use, giving another reason to settle into a preferred tool before moving on to new equipment. Jeremy Soule composed an atmospheric score early in his career. The different regions and the changing dog give the adventure a distinctive continuity: the surroundings become unfamiliar again, but the partnership makes each new place part of the same journey.
story_headings: A boy and his dog far from home
